# Light Language – apps.justbe.works

> Educational marketing site about “light language” / “language of light” in spirituality and meditation (including themes from the Beginning LL Student Manual, 2014), why it is **not a classical spoken language**, and the **Light Language Grid Creator** app—88 shapes, 144 colours, 90+ words/sets/stages, grids, PNG export—for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision ([App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/light-language-grid-creator/id6758855353)).

## Pages (human-written guides; not medical advice)

- English (default): https://apps.justbe.works/
- Deutsch: https://apps.justbe.works/de/
- Español: https://apps.justbe.works/es/
- Français: https://apps.justbe.works/fr/
- Italiano: https://apps.justbe.works/it/
- Português: https://apps.justbe.works/pt/

## One-page study PDFs (original summaries; not copies of the 2014 manual)

- EN: https://apps.justbe.works/assets/pdfs/beginning-light-language-summary-en.pdf
- DE: https://apps.justbe.works/assets/pdfs/beginning-light-language-summary-de.pdf
- ES: https://apps.justbe.works/assets/pdfs/beginning-light-language-summary-es.pdf
- FR: https://apps.justbe.works/assets/pdfs/beginning-light-language-summary-fr.pdf
- IT: https://apps.justbe.works/assets/pdfs/beginning-light-language-summary-it.pdf
- PT: https://apps.justbe.works/assets/pdfs/beginning-light-language-summary-pt.pdf

Regenerate (from this `website` folder): `python3 scripts/generate_manual_summaries.py` (install dependency once: `pip3 install fpdf2`)
